description: Get the sidereal (Lahiri) positions of the nine grahas and the ascendant for any date, time and place: sign, degree, nakshatra, pada and retrograde state. Defaults to now in New Delhi when date, time or place are omitted.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Omit with longitude for New Delhi.

time.description: Local time, HH:MM. Defaults to now.

name: get_planet_positions
title: Planet positions at a moment
